name: Brandur Ironhammer
summary: In Ironforge, Brandur Ironhammer guides young paladins in the Holy Light and sends them across the Alliance.

sections.title: A Guide in the Mystic Ward
sections.body: In the Hall of Mysteries, Brandur Ironhammer trains novice paladins in the ways of the Holy Light. He and Tiza Battleforge watch over young dwarven champions as they face the trials of the Tome of Divinity. Tiza has spoken frankly about Brandur’s personal flaws. He works to master his envy and keep the inner purity expected of a warrior of the Light.

sections.title: Connecting the Silver Hand
sections.body: Brandur connects Ironforge to the wider Alliance brotherhood. Human initiates who come to the dwarven mountain are sent south to Duthorian Rall in the Cathedral of Light. Seasoned paladins are directed to battlegrounds such as Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands. Veteran crusaders are sent to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for the demanding trials of the war charger.

faq.answer: Brandur Ironhammer is in the Hall of Mysteries, in the Mystic Ward on Ironforge’s northern side.

faq.q: What role does Brandur Ironhammer play for paladins?
faq.answer: Brandur Ironhammer trains new paladins, guides initiates through the Tome of Divinity, and directs seasoned paladins toward advanced trials across the Alliance.

faq.q: Who is Brandur's peer in the Hall of Mysteries?
faq.answer: Brandur works alongside Tiza Battleforge, another dwarven paladin trainer in the Hall of Mysteries. Tiza has pointed out his jealousy, and Brandur works to overcome it.

faq.q: Why does Brandur send paladins to Stormwind City?
faq.answer: Brandur sends human paladins training in Ironforge to Duthorian Rall or Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind’s Cathedral of Light for the formal rites of their own kingdom.

faq.q: Does Brandur have connections to the fight against the Scourge?
faq.answer: Yes. Brandur passes on urgent calls from Commander Ashlam Valorfist and sends paladins proven in purity and valor to aid the Alliance crusade at Chillwind Camp on the border of the Western Plaguelands.

angles.text: As a dwarven or Alliance paladin, you can learn martial skills and sacred seals from Brandur in Ironforge, then follow his directions toward advanced holy trials.
As a dwarf, you share the Khaz Modan tradition of paladins who join martial steel with reverence for the Holy Light in Ironforge.
